videos.title: Private Islands
videos.description: When you simply don't wish to be found, when you need to escape and unwind, there is no better place to disappear than here, an all-inclusive private tropical haven, one of Australia's unique resorts on the edge of the Great Barrier Reef.

videos.title: Road Less Traveled
videos.description: Jonathan encounters Romani, breaks into a circus and bikes through one of the largest wine cellars in the world on the way to Transnistria.

videos.title: Distant Shores
videos.description: Port Saint Louis; sailing out of the Mediterranean and down the Moroccan coast bound for Rabat.

videos.title: Top Travel Show
videos.description: Continue the tour of the Amazon before flying to a luxury escape in Rotorua, New Zealand.

videos.title: 5 Star Getaways
videos.description: This series is a sun-filled invitation to travel and visit all-inclusive five-star resorts throughout the world, their surroundings and the excursions one can do at each destination.

videos.description: Carefully crafted cuisine from the ancient culture of Japan can be found in Los Angeles.

videos.description: Questions from Bryan Golie; jet skis and boats come close to colliding.

videos.description: Cruising the luxury riverboat Aqua for an intimate encounter with the Peruvian Amazon, taking daily excursions deep into the rainforest with monkeys, piranhas, pink dolphins and more.

videos.title: Global Passport
videos.description: Host Christina Cindrich visits Seville, Spain, in the southern region of Andalusia, to experience flamenco dancing, gypsy women, regal horses, streets lined with lively neighborhood bars, and 320 days of sun.

videos.description: Heading to the great white North, kind of; we visit the city of Toronto; there we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower; we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame.
